D: An Amazon princess leaves her hidden island to stop a war she believes a god has started.
P: Serve dessert when Diana tastes ice cream for the first time in London.
S: Island platter of haloumi, feta and figs
Griddled haloumi, honey thyme feta, olives, fresh figs and warm pita
Olives, fresh figs, feta drizzled with honey and thyme, warm pita and haloumi griddled until golden with a squeeze of lemon, all on one big platter.
Beef, potato and onion in crimped shortcrust, English mustard on the side
Beef mince, diced potato and onion seasoned with plenty of pepper, folded into shortcrust half moons, crimped, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. English mustard.
thick-cut potatoes double fried until crisp, salted, in paper cones Belgian style with thick aioli

Thick-cut potatoes double fried until crisp and golden, salted and served Belgian style in paper cones with a thick garlic mayonnaise. Cut 1.2kg floury potatoes into 1cm batons, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes until soft but pale, drain and rest 20 minutes. Fry again at 180C for 3 minutes until deep golden and crisp. Salt well. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 grated garlic clove, a squeeze of lemon and 1 tsp Dijon. Serve the frites in paper cones with the mayo on top.
M: Beef chuck braised 3 hours in dark beer and Dijon, crisp double-fried fries
Beef chuck browned, onions cooked slowly, dark beer, thyme, bay and a little mustard, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Frites.
smoked cod, leek and potato, cream and chives, oatcakes, for the sniper's song at the piano

Scotland's smoked fish soup: smoked cod poached in milk with leek and potato, finished with cream and chives, with buttered oatcakes. Poach 500g smoked cod in 600ml milk with a bay leaf for 5 minutes, lift out and flake, keeping the milk. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 1 onion in 40g butter for 8 minutes. Add 600g diced potatoes and 400ml water and simmer 15 minutes. Mash about a third of the potato into the soup, then add the poaching milk, 100ml cream and the fish. Warm through, season with pepper and scatter chives. Serve with oatcakes and butter.
W: Diana's raspberry ripple ice cream cones
Homemade vanilla custard ice cream rippled with raspberry sauce

Rich vanilla custard ice cream churned and rippled with a sharp raspberry sauce, scooped into crisp waffle cones. Heat 300ml milk and 300ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 120g caster sugar, whisk in the hot milk and cook to 82C, stirring. Strain and chill overnight, then churn. Simmer 200g frozen raspberries with 50g sugar for 5 minutes, sieve and cool. Layer the ice cream and sauce in a container, swirl once with a knife and freeze 4 hours. Scoop into cones.
K: Veld Belgian ale with orange and honey
Belgian white ale over orange honey syrup and lemon, with an orange peel twist

Belgian white beer poured over a spoon of orange and honey syrup with a dash of lemon, served in stemmed glasses with a thick head and orange peel. Simmer the peeled zest of 1 orange with 60g honey, 60ml water and a pinch of crushed coriander seed for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Put 1 tbsp syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 chilled stemmed glasses. Pour a 330ml Belgian white ale slowly into each so it builds a head, and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
